fusion.r6: V15 unchanged: manifest stride1, four folds, flip TTA, trained stackers
fusion.extra_failure_policy: Any selected extra model fails or exceeds its time gate: restore the complete V15 Raptor slot for that run. Never silently redistribute its share.

screen.primary_bootstrap: paired study resampling of fixed final predictions; each resample must contain both labels in all twelve classes
screen.secondary_bootstrap: rerank all branches within each resample as a sensitivity check
screen.suspicion_policy: Above0.97 is a warning, not proof of leakage. Do not use that model's Gold58 improvement to automatically approve this submission. Record training provenance separately.
screen.combined_gate: Each retained candidate must pass individually; the fixed equal-rank group must also pass the same ensemble delta, probability and per-class thresholds. No subset or coefficient search.

runtime.cache_rule: Reuse byte-identical V15 384-volume/mask cache before 224 consumes and removes it. If training geometry differs, use the matching documented preprocessing, record separate decode cost and do not call it a cache hit.
